blocks.content: Latitudes determine the climatic zones of the Earth, whereas longitudes are essential for calculating local time and time zones across the globe.

rows: Complete circles of decreasing size towards poles
Semi-circles of equal length converging at poles
Local time determination & time zone calculation

items: The Tropic of Cancer (23.5° N) passes through 8 Indian states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram.
Indian Standard Meridian (82°30' E) passes through 5 states: Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh.
The International Date Line roughly follows the 180° meridian and deviates zig-zag to avoid dividing island nations into two different days.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Latitudes run horizontally (East-West) as parallel circles and measure distance North or South of the Equator.
Longitudes run vertically (North-South) as semi-circles converging at the poles, measuring distance East or West of the Prime Meridian.
The Equator (0°) is the longest parallel of latitude, whereas all meridians of longitude are equal in length.
Distance between longitudes decreases from the Equator towards the poles, where it becomes zero.
Earth rotates 360° in 24 hours, meaning 1° of longitude corresponds to a time difference of 4 minutes.
